check.name: lens.trust-boundary-probes
check.reason: Melian shares none of this text, which the reviewing host's store and terminal hold

message.text: The EEXIST lock diagnostic follows an attacker-controlled lock symlink and incorporates the target file's first space-delimited field into the error sink.

explanation.what: The EEXIST lock diagnostic follows an attacker-controlled lock symlink and incorporates the target file's first space-delimited field into the error sink.
explanation.whatToDo: Do not read an existing lock through its path for diagnostics; reject symlinks/non-regular files and use a non-content-based generic stale-lock error (or safely obtain only validated lock metadata).
explanation.whyHere: An invocation's output location can be placed next to a symlink to a private file, causing that file's content to be disclosed through the parity error output before any model runs.

properties.failureScenario: The probe built a real golden Git repository, loaded a valid Miss, resolved trust and policy, then set MELIAN_EVAL_PARITY_OUT to a temporary results path whose adjacent `.lock` was a symlink to a private file containing `PROBE_PRIVATE_TOKEN_7f30a data`. It ran measureParity through availability with model/range runners standing in and unreached. ResultsLock.take followed the link; measureHeld sent an error containing the token to printError and returned status 2. The private target remained unchanged. A separate Linux `/proc/self/environ` variant was attempted but did not disclose its synthetic variable.
